text: The authors have contractors rate critiques on a 1-7 ordinal scale for comprehensiveness (does not omit any clear and severe issue), critique-bug inclusion (CBI: catches a particular bug specified a priori), whether the critique includes any hallucinated bugs or nitpicks, and an overall subjective helpfulness rating that also accounts for style and general usefulness.
title: Critique evaluation attributes: comprehensiveness, critique-bug inclusion, hallucinations
